@graph.name: Primvaria
@graph.description: Open-source OpenUSD asset generators for robot simulation and Physical AI: grains, cloth, cables and small mechanical parts, every instance different, with UsdPhysics, tested in Blender and MuJoCo.
@graph.keywords: OpenUSD, asset generator, procedural assets, robot simulation, Physical AI, synthetic data, Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, Blender, UsdPhysics

@graph.name: Granulaire
@graph.description: Procedural granular assets for robot simulation: sand, gravel, pebbles, seeds, pellets and regolith with measured shapes and moisture states, exported to OpenUSD.

@graph.name: Maillage
@graph.description: Procedural cloth assets for robot simulation: towels, napkins, tablecloths, sheets, scarves and flags in real sizes and fabrics, exported to OpenUSD, MuJoCo flex and NVIDIA OmniPhysics.

@graph.name: Filaire
@graph.description: Procedural cable assets for robot simulation: standard cables, coaxial leads, robot and drone leads with male and female connectors and their receptacles, exported to OpenUSD with UsdPhysics joints.

@graph.name: Quincaillerie
@graph.description: Procedural hardware assets for robot simulation: threaded screws, nuts, washers, battery cells and holders with tolerances, defects and wear, exported to OpenUSD.
